notes.title: You Can Change Your Cursor Too!
notes.notes:
[h2]You Can Now Change Your Mouse Cursor[/h2]
[b]"Slippy Bear is 100% mouse control, so it would be nice if we could change the cursor"[/b]
You're absolutely right! Sorry for making you chase around Windows' boring default cursor all this time. (Though personally, I kind of like the Windows default cursor...)
This time, we've prepared cute cursors and cursors that will make you hungry. You can unlock them based on the number of crowns you have, so please try to collect them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550070/99825d3c9840eaea717cfa2887ac4eea9b1d189c.gif[/img]
[h2]What Are the Conditions for Getting Crowns?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550070/f50867b21fa99563e2347a98670d58b9649bbe0c.gif[/img]
[b]"Sometimes I can get crowns, sometimes I can't. What's the rule?"[/b]
This was confusing, wasn't it? Really sorry about that!
Actually, you get crowns when you "clear a stage within a specific time limit." But we didn't show how many seconds you needed in the game. From now on, you can check by pressing pause (Esc) during the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550070/9146a2bb67d1d58e5571309a8d1fa696e99c1d4f.png[/img]
[h2]Overall Game Balance Adjustment[/h2]
[b]"This game is way too hard!"[/b]
We're going with the high difficulty route. Thank you for always playing! ːsteamhappyː
